app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

id.description:
ID is BBB's identifier for the alert on this profile, also the anchor
in URL.

links.description: Links are the hyperlinks inside the notice, in order.

text.description: Text is the complete notice as plain text, one paragraph per line.

title.description: Title is BBB's heading for the alert.

type_id.description:
TypeID is BBB's numeric alert type. Seen so far: 8104 Pattern of
Complaint, 8108 Alert, 8111 Licensing. It is passed through as
published, not validated against a fixed list.

url.description: URL is the alert's own anchor on the profile's more-info page.

alerts.description:
Alerts lists the notices BBB attaches to the profile (pattern of
complaints, investigation results, licensing findings). It is an
empty list when the profile has none. An alert parsed without Text
means only the profile's alert list could be read.

canonical_url.description: BBB's own address for the profile, from the page. It differs from url when BBB has since changed the address, for example after moving the business to another local BBB: the business number at the end stays the same and the four-digit local BBB number before it changes.

hours.description:
Hours is genuinely conditional per-location -- confirmed both absent
(embedded state JSON "operatingHours":null on some profiles) and
present as a full 7-day table on others. An empty list here is a
real result, not a parser failure.

notice.example: This business profile is under review.

profile_under_review.description:
ProfileUnderReview is true when BBB is updating the profile. The page
then shows "This business profile is under review." (Notice) in place
of the rating and accreditation, so Rating is "NR", RatingReasons holds
BBB's sentence saying why, and "accredited" is left out of the JSON:
the page does not say, and false would be a claim BBB is not making.
Seen live 2026-10-12. The state is BBB's and lasts until the review
ends, so asking again returns the same answer.

total_complaints.description:
TotalComplaints, the two closed-complaint counts, TotalReviews and
AverageReviewRating are the counts BBB embeds in the profile page. A
count is left out when BBB did not publish it, so 0 is a real zero.
TotalComplaints is the figure the complaints page shows for the last
three years; use bbb-business-complaints for the list.

total_pages.description: TotalPages, HasMore and ResultsCapped follow SearchResponse.

status.description:
Status is one of BBB's fixed complaint-status values: Resolved,
Unresolved, Answered, Unanswered, Unpursuable. Passed through as
rendered rather than validated, since it is an upstream-controlled
response value, not a request parameter.

closed_last_12_months.description:
ClosedLast12Months and FiledLast12Months are the two wordings BBB uses
for the second summary line ("N complaints closed|filed in the last 12
months."). A page shows one of them; the other field is omitted.

complaints_list_incomplete.description:
ComplaintsListIncomplete is true when TotalComplaints is non-zero
but BBB's itemized complaint list came back empty anyway. Confirmed
live on at least one high-volume multi-location business (770 total
complaints, page rendered "There are no matching results. Improve
your results by removing some applied search filters." with no
filters actually applied by this client) -- an upstream filter/
pagination quirk, not a parser failure. It is also set for any first
page that counts complaints but lists none, whatever BBB renders in
place of the list. TotalComplaints/ClosedLast12Months remain
authoritative; Complaints will be empty even though real records
exist upstream. A page past the end of the list is not incomplete.

notice.example: This profile is currently being updated. You will not be able to read any existing complaints at this time, but you may file a complaint.

page.description:
Page is the page of the complaint list this response holds. TotalPages
is the last page BBB's own pager links to; it is omitted when BBB
renders no list (no complaints, or a page past the end). BBB lists
fewer complaints than TotalComplaints counts, so TotalPages can be
smaller than TotalComplaints/10. HasMore is true while Page is before
TotalPages.

profile_under_review.description:
ProfileUnderReview is true when BBB is updating the profile and has
taken the complaint summary and list off the page for the duration.
Notice is BBB's own sentence saying so. TotalComplaints and
ClosedLast12Months then come from the counts BBB still embeds in the
page and stay zero when it embeds none; Complaints is empty and
ComplaintsListIncomplete is true. Seen live 2026-10-12; the state is
BBB's, so asking again returns the same answer until the review ends.

published_complaints.description:
PublishedComplaints is how many complaints BBB publishes details for,
the ones the pages list. HiddenComplaints is how many it counts in
TotalComplaints without publishing them. Both come from the page's
embedded state and are left out when it does not carry them.

rating_reasons.description:
RatingReasons is the full per-factor reasons list from /more-info,
not the shallow single-bullet list bbb-business returns. Empty for
businesses whose page renders no reasons list (seen on A+ businesses).

service_areas.description:
ServiceAreas is the full list of counties/cities/regions this
business serves, confirmed untruncated live. Genuinely
business-conditional -- confirmed absent entirely on at least one
business (no #service-area section rendered at all), so an empty
list here is a real possible result, not a parser failure.

total_pages.description:
TotalPages is the last page BBB serves for this query and HasMore is
true while Page is before it. BBB stops a listing at 15 pages of 15, so
ResultsCapped marks a query whose TotalResults cannot all be reached by
paging; narrow it with filters to reach the rest. All three are left
out when BBB's listing data did not carry the page count.

news_url.description: The chapter's own newsroom; pass it to bbb-news or bbb-news-topics.
The chapter's own newsroom; pass it to bbb-news or bbb-news-topics.

published_news_url.description:
The first BBB-published program tile that links to a newsroom route.
It is absent when the chapter does not publish a matching tile.

formatted_address.example: 600 Beacon Parkway West, Suite 900, Birmingham, AL 35209

id.description: BBB's id of the story, event, or related local-service card.

type.description: BBB's content type: Article for a story, an event type for an event, or Near Me for a related local-service card.

url.description: Canonical BBB article URL, event URL, or related-service URL, according to Type.

city.description: City slug; present for a city URL.

country.description: Country of the newsroom: us or ca.

has_more.description: True while a later page exists; request page + 1 next and stop when it is false.

items.description: BBB's newsroom cards on this page, in source order. Near Me cards are preserved with type "Near Me".

local_bbb_id.description: Id of the local BBB chapter; present for a chapter URL.

local_bbb_name.description: Name of the local BBB chapter; present for a chapter URL.

page_size.description: BBB's page size. A page can hold fewer items than this with more pages after it.

source_url.description: The newsroom URL that was read, page query included.

state.description: Two-letter state or province code; present for a state or city URL.

topic.description: Topic name; present for a topic URL.

total.description: BBB's count of stories in the list. It can be slightly higher than the number of stories the pages hold.

total_pages.description: Number of pages BBB serves for the list, from its own pager; at least 1.

article_id.description:
The numeric ID in the requested URL when that was an article URL. The
evergreen page does not carry it.

body.description:
The page text in reading order: one paragraph, heading, list item or
table cell per block, separated by blank lines.

canonical_url.description: The address the page declares for itself.

final_url.description: The evergreen page the content was read from.

links.description: The links in the introduction and body, each once.

modified_at.description:
When BBB last edited the page, in UTC. Not the date of a story the
page replaced.

page_type.description: BBB's own name for the page template, passed through unchanged.

published_at.description:
Always null: BBB publishes no date for these pages. A value appears
only if BBB starts writing one into the page.

redirects.description:
Every redirect between requested_url and final_url, in order. Empty
when the requested URL is the evergreen page itself.

requested_url.description: The URL that was asked for, without any query string.

summary.description: The introduction shown under the title, when the page has one.

title.example: What to know before purchasing a gift card

status.description: The HTTP status BBB answered with.

name.description: Topic name as BBB shows it.

url.description: Newsroom URL of the topic in the requested scope; pass it to bbb-news.

city.description: City slug; present for a city URL.

country.description: Country of the newsroom: us or ca.

local_bbb_id.description: Id of the local BBB chapter; present for a chapter URL.

local_bbb_name.description: Name of the local BBB chapter; present for a chapter URL.

source_url.description: The newsroom URL that was read.

state.description: Two-letter state or province code; present for a state or city URL.

topics.description: Every topic the page lists, in name order, the active one included.

has_more.description:
Whether page+1 exists. When the page count is unknown, true while the
page is full. Request the next page only while this is true.

total_pages.description:
The last page of this search, from BBB's result count. Omitted when
that count is a lower bound (total_results_lower_bound) or missing.

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Returns published BBB article metadata, author names, body text, and useful links from a canonical public article URL on www.bbb.org or bbb.org. If BBB merges a story into another BBB article, the response contains the target article's id and source_url plus the original requested_url. Returns a permanent 404 when BBB moves the URL to an evergreen /all/ page or outside bbb.org, when BBB redirects the URL back to itself so it cannot be loaded, or when the URL resolves to a published non-article type such as an event; safe HTTPS destinations are named in the error and are never fetched.

parameters.description: Canonical BBB article URL on www.bbb.org or bbb.org
parameters.name: url

parameters.name: url

get.description: Returns a business's BBB complaint history: total complaint count, complaints closed or filed in the last 12 months, and one page of per-complaint detail (date, type, status, narrative text, and any business response / customer answer thread). Complaints are listed newest first, 10 per page; use page with the returned page, total_pages and has_more to walk the full list. A business with no filed complaints returns total_complaints 0 and an empty complaints list -- this is a normal result, not an error.

parameters.description: BBB business profile URL, from a bbb-search result's url or hq_profile_url. A location URL ending in /addressId/<number> is accepted and read from the business profile

parameters.description: Complaint list page, 1 or greater (10 complaints per page, newest first). Defaults to 1

Service area is business-conditional -- some businesses render no service-area section at all, in which case service_areas is empty.

parameters.description: BBB business profile URL, from a bbb-search result's url or hq_profile_url. A location URL ending in /addressId/<number> is accepted and read from the business profile

When BBB publishes a program tile linking to a recognized newsroom path, published_news_url and its descriptive published_news_title are also returned. get.description: Returns one page of BBB newsroom cards from a canonical BBB newsroom URL. Three scopes are accepted, each with an optional topic: the US or Canada newsroom (/us/news), a state, province or city newsroom (/us/ca/news, /us/ca/san-francisco/news), and one local BBB chapter's own newsroom (/local-bbb/<chapter>/news, the news_url returned by bbb-local-bbbs and bbb-local-bbb). The list is whatever BBB shows on that page: a city or chapter whose local BBB publishes its own stories returns those, and other cities, other chapters and the state pages checked so far return the same list as the country newsroom, so compare total and the first items with the country newsroom before treating a list as local. A chapter URL also returns local_bbb_id and local_bbb_name. Items preserve BBB's type and include Article stories, events, and Near Me related-service cards when present. Near Me URLs are restricted to BBB's /near-me/<slug> paths. Every page carries total_pages and has_more: request page + 1 while has_more is true and stop when it is false; a page past the end returns 404. Event dates and links are preserved when present.

parameters.description: Canonical https://www.bbb.org newsroom URL: /us/news or /ca/news; /<country>/<state>/news or /<country>/<state>/<city>/news with country us or ca, the two-letter region code from bbb-regions and the city slug from a business profile URL; or a chapter's news_url from bbb-local-bbbs. Append a topic segment from bbb-news-topics to narrow it and ?page=N (1 to 1000) to page; no other query key is accepted
parameters.name: url

get.description: Returns the complete topic navigation shown by a BBB newsroom page, including its active topic. The page can be the US or Canada newsroom, a state, province or city newsroom, or one local BBB chapter's newsroom; the returned topic URLs stay in that scope, and a chapter has its own topic set.

parameters.description: Canonical https://www.bbb.org newsroom URL, optionally with a topic segment: /us/news or /ca/news; /<country>/<state>/news or /<country>/<state>/<city>/news with country us or ca, the two-letter region code from bbb-regions and the city slug from a business profile URL; or a chapter's news_url from bbb-local-bbbs
parameters.name: url

get.description: Returns one page from the evergreen library BBB keeps under https://www.bbb.org/all/ (tips, topic hubs such as tax or holiday advice, scam studies): its title, introduction, body text, links, main image and last-modified time. BBB folds older newsroom stories into these pages and redirects the old article URL, so the url can be either the evergreen page itself or an article URL that bbb-article reports as moved; requested_url, final_url and every redirect between them are returned. published_at is always present and is null, because BBB publishes no date for these pages: modified_at is when BBB last edited the page, not when a story it replaced was published, and the page may cover a wider topic than that story did. The original article ID is not on the page; article_id repeats the one in the requested article URL. Returns 404 when the page does not exist, when an article URL has not been moved (read it with bbb-article), and when BBB redirects the URL somewhere outside /all/; the error names the destination and the answer is permanent. Content BBB loads in the browser for the visitor's local BBB is not included.

parameters.description: Canonical https://www.bbb.org URL of an evergreen page (/all/<path>, no query string) or of an article (/article/<type>/<id>-<slug>) that BBB has moved to one
parameters.name: url

get.description: Returns the complete current country and region list from BBB's public local directory. Use the returned region code with bbb-local-bbbs.

get.description: Searches bbb.org Scam Tracker's consumer-reported-scam database by free-text query, scam category, targeted-victim state/province, reported-scammer state/province, report-date range, and/or dollar-loss range, paginated 10 results/page. A verified search with no matches returns results: [] and total_results: 0; an unavailable or unrecognized page returns 503 rather than an empty list. When result cards are present but BBB's total count is unavailable, total_results is omitted. Every page returns has_more and, when BBB's result count is exact, total_pages: request the next page only while has_more is true, because a page past the end returns 404. Omit every filter to browse the most-recent-first feed. This is a separate BBB dataset from the bbb-search/bbb-business/bbb-business-complaints business-rating family -- consumer-reported scam incidents, not business ratings.
